# Thistledown Vets - sample runs

Daily sample runs to the laboratories, logged at the front desk.

The dispatch desks take changes by phone during opening hours; the duty vet
rings them when a run has to move.

turns.prompt: The courier has not turned up and this morning's samples are still in the fridge. Ring the Ruthven Laboratories dispatch desk and move the pickup to tomorrow morning, then tell me what they said.
